name: Karlo Ressler - Projet de décision du Conseil
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision on the conclusion of the Agreement between the European Union and the Republic of Serbia on operational activities carried out by the European Border and Coast Guard Agency in the Republic of Serbia
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees that the European Union should sign a deal with Serbia. Under this deal, the European Border and Coast Guard Agency can send its border teams to work in Serbia, including at Serbia's borders with countries outside the EU. The teams can carry out border control tasks there. The aim is to manage migration and improve security along the route through the Western Balkans. The Parliament asks the agency to keep it informed about these activities.

- The EU and Serbia will have a binding border cooperation agreement; EU border teams can be deployed on Serbian territory.
- It affects Serbia, EU border staff, and people moving along the Western Balkans migration route.
- Next, the agency must report its activities to the Parliament and include this cooperation in its annual reports.
